title: Open SOC SIEM: A zero-install security operations training platform with an attack simulator and log analyzer
description:
Open SOC SIEM is a zero-install, browser-based security operations training platform for students and researchers. Formerly released as Open-Clinic-SRA SIEM Demo (v1.0.x).

Contents: (1) an Attack Simulator with six scenarios mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and MITRE ATLAS, including indirect prompt injection against AI agents and federated learning poisoning; (2) a Log Analyzer that parses uploaded Linux syslog/auth, Apache/Nginx, JSON-lines and CSV logs entirely in the browser and explains each finding, with challenge mode and tunable rules; (3) a five-class threat taxonomy for clinical AI agents; (4) a deterministic synthetic labeled event dataset (340 events) with baseline detectors; (5) sample logs and teaching materials (lecture plan, three labs, instructor key).

All bundled data is synthetic. Detections in the Attack Simulator are scripted for teaching; the Log Analyzer uses simple, transparent teaching rules.
